prompt_package.goal_summary: Fix a real photo that is too dark, too dull or slightly damaged, without changing the people in it.

user_profile.who: Someone with a phone photo that matters: family, listing, or archive

blocks.task: Repair the attached photo. {{repair_goal}}. Keep every person, object and piece of text exactly as it is.
blocks.subject: The same people with the same faces, same ages, same expressions, same clothing. Same objects in the same positions.
blocks.scene: The original setting, framing and perspective, unchanged. Do not crop and do not extend the background.
blocks.camera: Identical framing to the source. Sharp where the source is sharp. No lens distortion added.
blocks.light: {{light_goal}}. Shadows stay soft. No blown highlights. Skin keeps its real texture with pores and fine lines visible.
locks: Faces are identical to the source. Do not beautify, slim, smooth or age anyone.
Text, signs, labels and numbers in the photo stay identical.
The composition is identical. Nothing is added or removed except the damage I mention.
avoid: new objects added to fill space
color casts turned into Instagram filters

input_schema.description: Say the goal in plain words. One goal per run works best.

fields.name: repair_goal
fields.example: Lift the shadows so faces are visible and remove the white scratch across the top left corner

fields.name: light_goal
fields.example: Correct to warm late-afternoon light as if the sun were low on the left
fields.default: Correct to natural daylight with no color cast

output_schema.description: Repaired image plus a side-by-side duty.

fields.name: compare_note
fields.example: Open both at 100% and check eyes, hands and text before saving.

examples.title: Dark family scan, scratch on corner

example_input.repair_goal: Lift the shadows so faces are visible and remove the white scratch across the top left corner

example_output.compare_note: Eyes and hands match; scratch gone; grain preserved.

example_input.repair_goal: Brighten the room, straighten the vertical lines and remove the photographer's reflection in the window
example_input.light_goal: Soft daylight from the windows, no artificial lamp glow

example_output.compare_note: Furniture positions unchanged; window shows sky, not a person.

non_obvious_insights: One repair per run. 'Fix the light and remove the scratch and change the background' fails, because each change pulls on the others.
Forbid beautification explicitly. The default edit direction smooths skin and thins faces; that reads as a different person.
Add 'keep the grain' when scanning old photos. Grain is what makes a repair look like a photo and not a render.
Hands, eyes and small text are the three places errors hide. Check all three at 100% before you pay for a 4K run.
Keep the original file untouched and save the repaired copy beside it. Never overwrite a family photo.
For listings, forbid changing furniture layout. Buyers compare photos to the walkthrough and notice.
Real-estate note: some platforms require disclosure of edited images. State the edit in the listing text.
monetization_ideas: Offer photo restoration for families: per-photo price, tiered by damage.
Bundle listing-photo cleanup for realtors: 25 photos, one flat fee, 24-hour turnaround.
Sell a 'scan day' package to local historical societies, priced per 50 images.
Add a print-ready 4K upsell to any restoration order.
Teach a 30-minute class on preserving family photos; the JSON is the take-home checklist.
prompt_package.reusability_notes: Same package fixes glare, red-eye-adjacent color casts, faded prints and flat phone photos. Swap repair_goal only. For batch work, keep settings fixed and loop over images; for products, use the product-hero package instead because this one forbids composition changes.
